component.name: Zerkalo
component.summary: Typst editor with live preview, LSP completions, and git sync

description.p: Zerkalo is a GTK4 editor for Typst documents with a focus on academic and contemplative writing. It embeds the Typst compiler directly — no external binary required — and renders a live preview as you type.
Editor features:

ul.li: Multi-file tabs with modified indicator and inline compile-error dots
Syntax highlighting, find and replace, auto-pair brackets
Ctrl+B / Ctrl+I bold and italic formatting with toggle-off support
LSP completions via bundled tinymist — type # for a popup
Citation autocomplete — type @ for fuzzy BibTeX key search with smart popup positioning
Spell check with suggestions, Ignore All, and language selector; typewriter scrolling option
Word count, reading time, word-count goal, session delta, and section word count
Command palette (Ctrl+K) — fuzzy search over commands and headings
Breadcrumb bar with heading path and section word count
Simple Mode — hides Typst front-matter, shows format bar, and hides line numbers for a clean writing view
Configurable keybindings via keybindings.toml

description.p: Document workflow:

ul.li: New from Template — dialog generates a complete Typst preamble
Import from LaTeX, Word, Markdown, ODT, HTML, EPUB, RTF, or PDF via pandoc — drag-and-drop, batch/folder import, Paste as Document, and an Import History with retry, undo, and search
Export to PDF, HTML, DOCX, ODT, or LaTeX; Ctrl+Shift+E for instant PDF export
Citation style switcher — APA, Chicago, GOST 7.32, and more, plus custom CSL styles
BibTeX and Hayagriva YAML bibliography support, with cited-only bibliography export and project-wide citation key rename
Compile on save with live preview; scroll position preserved across recompiles
Auto-save to recovery file on idle; periodic save every 30 seconds
Git sync — commit and push to all remotes in one click

description.p: Sidebar:

ul.li: Document outline with cursor-tracking highlight
File tree, citation panel (click-to-insert), plan scratchpad, and section notes
Symbol insert panel for Cyrillic, Greek, Hebrew, and Sanskrit
Snapshot history with diff view and restore

description.p: Document Library (Ctrl+L):

ul.li: SQLite-backed library of all your Typst documents with search, sort, and filter
Organise with projects, categories (with colours), and frequency heat-coloured tags
Card view with prose word count; compact single-line view for dense lists
Pinned documents, trash (soft delete with restore), archive, and bulk operations
Create new documents from templates; import BibTeX author names as tags
Auto-registers any .typ file opened in the editor

description.p: 0.16.0 "Open Harbor" — universal document import, readable errors, visual polish.

ul.li: Added: import documents from LaTeX, Word, Markdown, ODT, HTML, EPUB, RTF, and PDF via ☰ → Import, drag-and-drop, or Paste as Document
Added: batch/folder import, preview-before-commit dialog, and an Import History with retry, undo, search, duplicate warnings, and citation-manager detection for DOCX
Added: dropcap color picker, the Marginalia package, "LaTeX Look" template preset, and custom page/margin/font-size fields
Fixed: error messages are now genuinely readable — working Fix It suggestions, accurate error-line highlighting, and plain-language explanations for common mistakes
Fixed: status bar, word-count goal ring, and library empty-state visual polish; unreadable diff colors and uncolored tag/category chips

description.p: 0.15.1-dev2 — LaTeX Look template, custom page settings.

ul.li: Added: "LaTeX Look" template preset with Computer Modern typography and its own paragraph/heading rhythm
Added: "LaTeX" and "Ross" margin presets, including a true relative-length 1/3-page margin
Added: custom page size, margins, and font size fields in New from Template / Update Template Settings

description.p: 0.15.1-dev1 — preview word-jump, theming and UI-consistency pass.

ul.li: Added: double-click a word in the preview to jump to it in the source
Fixed: diff colors unreadable in light mode, uncolored categories all rendering as the same blue, a redundant duplicate zoom/page toolbar in the preview area
Changed: consolidated app-wide CSS into one file; LSP status and compile-mode colors now resolve live from the active theme

description.p: 0.15.0 "Steady Hand" — citation management, data-loss fixes, correctness pass.

ul.li: Added: Hayagriva YAML bibliography support, custom CSL styles, cited-only bibliography export, project-wide citation key rename, click-to-insert completions

Fixed: several data-loss and crash bugs — Replace All wiping the preamble, wrong-tab saves, template dialog overwrites, compiler panics and text corruption on non-ASCII input, a preview scroll memory leak, wrong upgrade defaults, silently-discarded git rebase failures, and an LSP multi-header parsing bug
Fixed: preview pane drift while typing, incorrect library "created" dates, non-atomic snapshot writes, and missing mandated heading numbering on style switch

description.p: 0.14.4-dev3 — completion click-to-insert, preview jump fixes.

ul.li: Added: click a completion popup row to insert it immediately
Removed: citation hover preview
Fixed: preview pane no longer drifts/jumps while typing

description.p: 0.14.4-dev2 — citation management improvements.

ul.li: Added: Hayagriva YAML bibliography support (read-only) alongside BibTeX
Added: custom CSL style support via a user-supplied .csl file
Added: citation hover preview showing author/year and title
Added: export a cited-only bibliography from the reference manager
Added: project-wide citation key rename from the reference manager
Changed: BibTeX parsing now uses the biblatex crate for better edge-case handling

description.p: 0.14.4-rc1 — data-loss and crash fixes.

ul.li: Fixed: Replace All in Simple Mode wiped the document preamble permanently
Fixed: closing a background tab via Save would save the wrong (foreground) tab
Fixed: Update Template Settings dialog could overwrite edits made while it was open
Fixed: compiler panicked on documents with non-ASCII characters when a compile error occurred

description.p: 0.14.3 "Firm Ground" — undo button reliability fix.

ul.li: Fixed: undo/redo buttons could grey out incorrectly when multiple files were open; background tab state no longer interferes with the active tab's button sensitivity

description.p: 0.14.2 "Burnished Folio" — CV/Résumé support, library PDF export, UI polish.

ul.li: CV/Résumé templates — three presets (Modern, Academic, Classic) in the New from Template dialog, each with a fully distinct visual identity throughout
CV helpers — #section, #job, #edu, #skill, #award functions embedded in every CV; all adapt automatically to the active style
CV-aware format bar — the Style button is replaced by a CV Style button when a CV is open; one-click style switching rewrites the document in place
CV snippets — the # completion popup shows CV-specific completions when editing a CV file
CV-aware cheatsheet — the ? reference panel and Help popup switch to a CV helper reference when editing a CV
Library PDF export — the Export button in the document library now compiles to PDF using the embedded Typst compiler
Hamburger menu reorganized — cleaner groups with Update Template Settings restored to the menu
Fixed: switching CV style via the format bar wiped the entire document preamble
Fixed: cheatsheet/help panel code blocks could drift left unpredictably

description.p: 0.14.1 "Quiet Brass" — Library status bar, compile mode toggle, visual polish.

ul.li: Library status bar — doc/project count and last-opened info at the bottom of the doc panel; "Compact" toggle lives there too
Compile mode status bar toggle — click "on save / auto / manual" to cycle modes; label turns amber in manual, green in auto
Sidebar count badges — each filter row shows a pill badge with the matching document count
Doc list empty state — centred placeholder when a filter or search returns no results
Pinned docs divider — separator row between pinned and unpinned documents
Compile pulse animation — compile button fades in and out while compiling
Preview zoom step buttons — − and + flank the zoom percentage in the preview bar
Goal ring celebration — ring flashes bright green for 900 ms when the word count goal is reached
Tab overflow fade — right-edge gradient on the tab header hints at scrollable overflow
Tag-from-citation now produces "Lastname, Firstname" for all BibTeX author formats

description.p: 0.14.1-dev1 — Reliability and startup polish (phases 3–6).

ul.li: Library database now loads on a background thread — window appears immediately on startup
Typewriter scroll and heading-based preview sync are now debounced to reduce jank
Tab switching, find bar Escape, command palette close, and sidebar Tab key all return focus to the editor
Closing a modified tab now shows a Save / Discard / Cancel dialog
File watcher deduplicates rapid external writes; background tabs no longer trigger spurious recompiles
Git sync conflict shows a clear targeted message instead of raw git output
Changing the work folder in Settings now shows a restart-required notice

description.p: 0.14.0 "Lucid Archive" — Library search, hierarchy, and polish.

ul.li: Search bar now matches tag names and category names, not just document titles
New Category button in the sidebar with colour picker — no longer need to open a document first
Two-rank category hierarchy — assign a parent to any category; parent rows show a combined doc count and filter to all children
Notes visible in the library — first line shown under tags in card view; full text as a tooltip in compact view
Bulk tagging is now additive — existing tags are preserved when applying new ones to a selection
Database indexes added for faster filter switches on large libraries
Several library correctness fixes: Recent badge count, category backfill after migration, title extraction, and auto-save registration

description.p: 0.13.12 "Amber Index" — Document Library.

ul.li: Document Library (Ctrl+L) — browse, search, and organise all your Typst files in one place, backed by a local SQLite database
Filter sidebar with Projects, Categories, Tags, Recently Opened, Untagged, Trash, and Archive; Trash and Archive always pinned visible below the scrollable list
Card and compact list views; card view shows prose word count (excluding commands, code blocks, and citations)
Tags with heat colouring — most-used tags are red, middle yellow, least-used blue
BibTeX author import — create tags from author names in your .bib file, filtered to entries actually cited in the document
Projects, categories with colours, pinned documents, bulk operations, document templates, notes, and export

description.p: 0.13.12-dev3 — Fix scroll jump after right-click context menu.

ul.li: Editor no longer scrolls back to the selected paragraph after dismissing a right-click context menu.

description.p: 0.13.12-dev2 — Fix context menu scroll jump.

ul.li: Right-clicking and clicking away to dismiss the context menu no longer causes the editor to jump to the cursor position.

description.p: 0.13.11 "Steady Gaze" — Fix horizontal view snap on click.

ul.li: Clicking in the editor no longer snaps text against the left edge in Simple Mode or hides it behind line numbers in regular mode.
Typewriter scroll no longer snaps the view horizontally when recentering the cursor on a new line.

description.p: 0.13.10 "Steady Quill" — Crash fixes and faster dev builds.

ul.li: Two SIGABRT crashes on typing eliminated — GTK RefCell borrow conflicts in the change handler, mark_saved, save_all_modified, mark_diagnostics, and clear_diagnostic_marks.
Spell popover dismissal no longer jumps the document scroll position.
Flatpak dev builds now recompile only the zerkalo crate (~30 s vs ~3 min) when dependencies are unchanged.

description.p: 0.13.9 "True Shore" — Mouse selection, word count, export, and paragraph spacing.

ul.li: Running header option in the template dialog Layout tab (None, Title, Author, Current Section, and combinations).
Mouse text selection no longer causes wild viewport jumps when the editor gains focus.
Status bar word count no longer inflates with Typst code, citations, or bibliography; document statistics window uses the same clean count.
HTML, DOCX, ODT, LaTeX, and EPUB export no longer fail due to heading show rules; existing documents are migrated automatically.
Uniform double-spacing between paragraphs in Chicago, SBL, Turabian, Harvard, MLA, APA, and ASA styles.

description.p: 0.13.8 "Still Water" — Template dialog redesign, preview startup fix, release notes width.

ul.li: Preview always opens the same file as the editor on startup.
Template dialog: full-height tab sidebar; new "Template" tab with gallery as first tab; Quick Settings removed; dialog doubled in width.
Release notes window text now wraps correctly within the window bounds.
Removed Drafting package from Packages tab — caused compile errors with Typst 0.14.
Project root no longer used when the project toggle is OFF.

description.p: Project controls, cursor sync, build log, and Simple Mode polish.

ul.li: New "project" toggle in the status bar reveals inline root-file controls (Set…, Clear, filename) — no file-tree right-click needed.
Root-file suggestion banner only shown when project toggle is ON.
Bib file picker button in the Citations sidebar header; active filename shown inline.
Cursor movement in the editor now scrolls the preview to the matching position.
Compile spinner shows elapsed seconds; status label shows page count and timing.
Build Log panel (collapsible) shows raw Typst stderr on compile failure.
Simple Mode hides line numbers, adds left margin, and hides template marker comments.
Preview toolbar "Help" toggle replaces the icon-only ? button.
Fixed crash (SIGABRT) on cursor move due to glib 0.18 SourceId::remove() panic.
Spell-check context menu no longer resets scroll position to top.

description.p: Simple mode, project toggle, and Help toggle polish.

ul.li: Simple Mode now hides the body-separator comment lines ("DO NOT DELETE" warning and decorative rule) in addition to the preamble.
Project controls in the status bar are now behind a toggle (default OFF); clicking "project" reveals root-file controls inline.
The preview toolbar help button is now a labelled "Help" toggle instead of an icon-only "?" button.

description.p: Project button in status bar.

ul.li: New "project" menu button in the status bar opens a popover for root-file management.
Shows the active root filename; bold label when a root is set.
Set Root File picker and Clear button available without the file-tree right-click menu.

description.p: Simple mode left margin.

ul.li: In Simple Mode the editor text is now indented 40 px from the left edge instead of flush at 8 px.

description.p: Bib file picker in Citations sidebar.

ul.li: Folder-open button in the Citations header opens a file chooser for .bib files.
Active bibliography filename shown in the Citations header.
Selecting a file saves it to config and reloads the citation list immediately.

description.p: Fix crash on cursor move.

ul.li: Fixed SIGABRT caused by calling SourceId::remove() on an already-expired glib source in the reverse-sync debounce timer.

description.p: Phase 3 & 4: reverse sync, build log, compile timer.

ul.li: Cursor movement in the editor scrolls the preview proportionally (debounced 300 ms).
Compile spinner shows elapsed seconds while compiling.
Collapsible Build Log panel shows raw Typst stderr on compile failure.
Compile status label shows page count and timing on success, error indicator on failure.

description.p: Simple mode polish.

ul.li: Line numbers hidden when Simple Mode is active.
Word wrap button removed from toolbar (still available in Settings).
Format bar auto-shows when Simple Mode is turned on.
Fixed right-click context menu resetting scroll to top of document.

description.p: Search toggle, font dropdown, preview stability.

ul.li: Compile button added in header beside the Preview toggle.
Auto compile is now the default for new installs.
Search toggle is bold when active, visible when inactive.
Font dropdown minimum width increased to 260 px.
Fixed preview scroll jumping after recompile in auto-fit mode.
Resolved all 31 compiler warnings.

description.p: Performance, format bar, and colour polish.

ul.li: Font dropdown now shows fonts enabled in Font Management, scrollable.
Added 18pt, 20pt, 24pt to size dropdown.
Table grid cells are now visible; hovering highlights the selected range.
Custom rows × cols input added to the table picker.
Manual compile defaults to on; word count and comment highlights debounced.
LSP status colours adapt to light/dark; comment highlight follows accent colour.
Syntax scheme tries kate/monokai-extended first for better contrast.

description.p: Warning cleanup — no user-facing changes.
Error panel improvements 2.

ul.li: Filter entry above the error list narrows rows in real time.
Identical errors are deduplicated; source context snippet shown per row.
File group headers when errors span multiple files.
"Last clean compile: HH:MM" appears when errors clear.
Save error log button writes to ~/.local/share/zerkalo/error_log.txt.
Ctrl+E focuses the first error row for keyboard-only navigation.

description.p: Error panel improvements.

ul.li: Error panel header shows "Compile Errors — N errors, M warnings" breakdown.
Error list collapses/expands via a chevron button; auto-expands on new errors.
Copy button on each row copies message and location to clipboard.
Jump-to-error button on each row makes navigation explicit.
Error rows are keyboard-navigable (Browse selection mode, Enter activates).
Try-Fix button for "unexpected end of file" appends missing closing delimiters (undoable).
Stuck indicator appears after 3 consecutive identical error sets.
Window title shows error count while compile errors are present.
Compile errors and LSP diagnostics have distinct section labels.
Success toast only shown when recovering from a previous error state.

description.p: Accessibility pass 2.

ul.li: Format bar popovers trap focus on open and return focus to editor on close.
All three format bar popovers close on Escape (autohide).
Status bar toggles (focus, format bar, autocorrect, simple mode) now report aria-pressed state.
Editor view is labelled "Document editor" with multiline role for screen readers.
Error panel severity icons carry accessible labels ("Compile error"/"Compile warning").
Alt+Enter opens spell suggestions for the word under the cursor.
CSS transitions and animations are suppressed when GNOME "Reduce Animations" is enabled.
Tab accessible label reflects unsaved state ("filename — unsaved").

description.p: Accessibility pass 1.

ul.li: All icon-only buttons now have accessible labels for screen readers.
Table grid cells announce their size as the user hovers.
Preview pane accepts keyboard focus: +/- zoom, 0 fit-width, Space/Shift+Space scroll.
Error panel announces compile errors via a live region without requiring focus to move.
Status bar toggles now render at higher contrast (70% opacity inactive, 100% on focus/hover).
Fixed: duplicate table grid click handler removed.

description.p: Format bar power features and header cleanup.

ul.li: Font and font size dropdowns in the format bar change document settings via the sidecar.
Insert Table button: hover an 8×8 grid to pick size, click to insert a Typst table block.
Insert Image button: file dialog inserts a #figure(image(...)) snippet.
Focus mode moved from header icon to status bar toggle.
Preview button is now a flat toggle — bold when preview is visible, regular when hidden.
"Structure" label above the outline panel removed.

description.p: Popup and format bar fixes.

ul.li: Double-click and Enter now correctly insert in citation and LSP completion popups.
Bold/Italic toolbar buttons now match Ctrl+B/I behaviour exactly.
Heading buttons toggle off when clicked on a line that already has that heading level.
Format bar toggle reads live widget state, fixing incorrect behaviour when loading config with format_bar_visible=false.
Ghost text placeholder shown in empty editor buffers.

description.p: New-user UX pass.

ul.li: Formatting toolbar with Bold, Italic, H1–H3, and page-break buttons; hideable via status bar toggle.
First-run welcome screen shows a layout diagram and getting-started guide for new installs.
Auto-detects .bib files in the project folder when no bibliography is configured.
Template gallery previews the first preset automatically on open.
Citation popup now shows "Smith et al., 2019" labels and searches by author name.

description.p: Bug-fix and polish release.

ul.li: Non-ASCII file paths (Cyrillic, spaces) no longer silently corrupt on open.
Writing streak survives until midnight before the first write of the day.
File deletes (open dropdown and file tree) now move to system trash with confirmation.
Simple Mode explanation merged into the Welcome window; first-run modal removed.
Welcome window and Setup Wizard now chain correctly instead of racing on independent timers.
Multiple missing-tool alerts consolidated into one dialog.
LSP diagnostic flicker on keystrokes eliminated.
Progress bar timer leak on rapid recompile fixed.
Tab switch no longer recompiles unchanged content.
Save As pre-fills untitled.typ and auto-appends .typ extension.

description.p: Completion popup fixes: no longer steals focus or blocks typing; no longer covers the cursor; appears immediately on # with built-in snippets then merges LSP results; arrow keys skip filtered-out rows; Escape deletes the typed #word.

Completion popup client-side filter (shows all completions, narrows as you type); numbering format selector (Decimal / IEEE Roman / Alpha); Preview Code button in template dialog; IEEE/GOST/Vancouver numbering now user-controlled; heading numbers now actually render in all styles; Outline/Symbols panel buttons use symbolic icons.

Vancouver citation style; font size and numbered-heading toggle in template dialog; #lorem() counted in word counts; abstract preserved on Update Template; GOST style correctly named and wired; preview no longer scrolls on mouse click; LSP popup closes on click-away; app screenshot added for Discover.

Ctrl+B/I bold/italic; Ctrl+Shift+E instant PDF export; section word count in breadcrumb bar; compile progress stripe. Citation popup fixed: no focus steal, correct positioning, full list. Preview scroll preserved. GOST style corrected. Page shadows, accent modified-dot, status bar separators.
Section word count moved to the breadcrumb bar, between the heading path and the word-wrap button.
Ctrl+B/I for bold/italic; section word count in status bar; compile progress stripe in header. Preview pages now have drop shadows; status bar has group separators; modified-dot uses accent color.
Ctrl+Shift+E exports PDF directly to the document folder. Window title shows the document title field or first heading instead of filename. Citation sidebar now inserts on single click.
Fix: auto-compile no longer dies after typing @. Fix: GOST style now uses correct bundled style name gost-r-705-2008-numeric.
Citation popup: bottom edge now clears the cursor line when appearing above it.
Citation popup: no longer steals focus; smart position above/below cursor; errors suppressed while typing citation key. GOST bibliography uses gost-r-7-0-5 with // separators.
Citation popup repositioned to avoid blocking the cursor; full bibliography shown. GOST style now uses footnote citations. Breadcrumb separator changed to /. Style button has no dropdown arrow.
Style button arrow hidden; "Experimental mode" renamed from "Developer mode"; preview scroll position preserved across recompiles.
LSP status dot is green when running, red on error. Completion popup is alphabetically sorted; double-click inserts.
Fix Simple Mode: preamble re-hidden after Update Template or Style change; hidden text no longer dropped during save or compile.
Simple Mode toggle in status bar: hides Typst front-matter above the document body. Style dropdown moved to the toolbar. Open-tabs button removed.
Fix: preview pane scroll works immediately after first compile, without needing to resize the pane.
Fix DOCX/LaTeX import: all pandoc preamble blocks (#set, #show, #let conf) now stripped correctly so imported files compile cleanly.
Fix LaTeX and DOCX import inside flatpak (pandoc now routed via flatpak-spawn --host). Error panel shows "Line N" for each error.
Export for Web: converts the active Typst file to an HTML fragment via pandoc; footnotes become hover tooltips that respond to light/dark mode.
Delete button (trash icon) beside every file in the open dropdown — confirmation dialog, closes tab if open, removes from list.

Changelog window renders release notes with proper formatting. Lock buttons on Author/Affiliation in template dialog. Flatpak now sources locally — no push needed for test builds. RC versioning scheme introduced. Setup wizard widened.
Right-click any editor tab to close it or delete the file (with confirmation). Fix: app no longer re-creates old project folder on launch. Author/affiliation lock compile fix.
Start maximized. Setup wizard is resizable again. tinymist and pandoc shown as bundled (always verified); only git and hunspell show install instructions.
Update What's New window to reflect 0.12.29 features: single-file workspace, status bar layout changes, page gaps in preview, session restore, accurate LCS snapshot diffs, and popout maximize button.

Status bar: autocorrect and GOST toggles moved left; Style dropdown and Draft/Final toggle moved to status bar right (Draft is bold). Preview: 20px gray page gaps for clear page boundaries. Session restore: opens last file on startup. Snapshot diff: proper LCS diff instead of positional comparison. Setup wizard: fixed size, flatpak tool detection fixed. Popout preview: maximize button added.

Color-coded diff views: removed lines red, added lines green, git hunk headers blue. Fix history panel click not working (same connect_activate bug as snapshots). Document Statistics now uses proper adw::ActionRow layout instead of monospace text.
Fix Browse Snapshots: clicking a snapshot now updates the diff view and enables the Restore button (was using connect_activate which only fires on Enter, not single click).

Fix preview pane size resetting on open (pane position now ignored during initial GTK layout). Fix git sync using wrong directory (now uses git rev-parse to find repo root from active file). Remove leftover Open Project Folder and Recent Projects menu items.

Single-file workspace: removed project mode entirely. The active tab is always the compilation root — no root chip, no "Set as Compilation Root", no project config root_file. Removes ProjectModel, is_project_mode flag, New Project wizard, and Project Settings dialog.

Fix crash when clicking headings in multi-file project outline (jump deferred to idle to avoid reentrancy). Fix compile ignoring changes in project mode (is_project_mode flag now correctly detects explicit project vs. single-file). Fix Ctrl+S resetting project root. Fix "Project Settings…" chip row doing nothing (popover now dismissed correctly before showing dialog). Add "Clear root file" to the chip popover so users can exit project mode.

Root chip now shows "Project Settings…": clicking the compilation root chip opens a popover with candidate root files and a Project Settings row at the bottom. Outline filenames moved to hover tooltip so section names are fully readable.

Fix live preview not updating while typing in a multi-file project: the debounced change handler was overriding the compilation root with the active tab on every keystroke. Also bumps flatpak runtime to GNOME Platform 50.

Fix crash when clicking files in a multi-file project (double-borrow panic in tab-switch handler). Fix compile button resetting the project compilation root on every tab switch. Fix tinymist, pandoc, git history, and pdftotext inside the flatpak sandbox.

Fix startup git warning in the flatpak (now checks via flatpak-spawn --host). Welcome window updated with current 0.12 features. GOST Type B font bundled in Kopilka, Rubric, and Zerkalo flatpaks so it is available to Typst documents and the UI font toggle inside the sandbox.

Template build system: templates are now real .typ files editable without touching Rust; user templates auto-load from ~/.config/zerkalo/templates/. New Chapter button creates a file and inserts #include in main.typ. Project Settings dialog for per-project root and bibliography. Cross-file outline shows headings from all project files.

Multi-file project system: New Project wizard with four templates (Blank, Essay, Journal/Thesis, Theological Journal), compilation root indicator (★) in the file tree, status bar root chip with quick-switch popover, collapsible directory rows, #include and #import insert helpers, and session-restore fixes for newly created projects.
Flatpak fixes: git sync now works via flatpak-spawn --host; Typst package cache (~/.cache/typst) is now accessible inside the sandbox.
Strip debug symbols from flatpak binaries to reduce package size.
Git Remotes dialog now includes a Primary Remote section for viewing and editing the origin URL.
